_note: Proposed tradition nodes (wisegraph traditions shape: id, parent, name). kashmir-shaivism, vajrayana and siddha-yoga already exist; do not duplicate. Clip rows use these ids in tradition/traditions[].

schools.name: Śaivism
schools.note: Umbrella for Śiva-centred traditions: the ascetic Atimārga and the initiatory Mantramārga.

schools.name: Pāśupata (Atimārga)
schools.note: Earliest Śaiva ascetic order; ash, feigned madness, provoking censure.

schools.name: Śaiva Siddhānta
schools.symbol: Śiva liṅga with three lines of ash
schools.note: Mainstream ritual Śaivism of the Mantramārga; Sanskrit āgamas, later the Tamil Śaiva temple tradition. Kauai Aadheenam teaches a monistic form.

schools.name: Kashmir Shaivism (non-dual Śaiva Tantra)
schools.symbol: Śiva–Śakti in one (ardhanārīśvara) or trident of three goddesses
schools.note: EXISTING node (school under hindu). Proposed parent: shaivism. Covers Trika, Pratyabhijñā, Spanda and Krama as practised in Kashmir.

schools.name: Trika
schools.symbol: triśūla with three goddesses Parā, Parāparā, Aparā
schools.note: Abhinavagupta's synthesis around the Mālinīvijayottara; Tantrāloka.

schools.name: Pratyabhijñā (Recognition)
schools.note: Philosophical school: liberation as recognising oneself as Śiva.

schools.name: Spanda (Vibration)
schools.note: Śiva Sūtras and Spanda Kārikās: consciousness as pulsation.

schools.name: Krama / Kālīkula (Mahārtha)
schools.symbol: Kālī with the wheel of twelve Kālīs
schools.note: Kālī-centred phases (krama) of cognition; Twelve Kālīs.

schools.name: Kaula / Kula
schools.note: Clan (kula) cults of yoginīs and Bhairava; source of many later Śākta and haṭha practices.

schools.name: Śāktism
schools.note: Goddess-centred traditions; parent of Kaula, Śrī Vidyā and Kālī lines.

schools.name: Śākta practice (Kālī, Kāmākhyā, Bhairavī)
schools.note: Bucket for living goddess practice not tied to a single classical school (Kāmākhyā upāsanā, Linga Bhairavi, Daśa Mahāvidyā).

schools.name: Śrī Vidyā
schools.note: Worship of Lalitā Tripurasundarī through the Śrī Chakra and the fifteen-syllable mantra.

schools.name: Nāth / Siddha Siddhānta
schools.note: Nāth yogī order (Gorakhnāth); Siddha Siddhānta Paddhati; alchemy and haṭha.

schools.name: Haṭha Yoga (premodern)
schools.symbol: figure in a seated posture with mudrā
schools.note: Physical-yogic methods first set out in Vajrayāna and Śaiva circles (Amṛtasiddhi, Dattātreyayogaśāstra, Haṭhapradīpikā).

schools.name: Vajrayāna (Indian tantric Buddhism)
schools.note: EXISTING node. Here: its Indian origins and its borrowings from Śaiva/Śākta tantra (Sanderson's thesis; Isaacson, Szántó, Mallinson on the Amṛtasiddhi).

schools.name: Siddha Yoga
schools.note: EXISTING lineage node; kept as the modern channel through which Kashmir Shaiva texts reached Kempton, Shankarananda, Muller-Ortega.

schools.name: Academic study of tantra
schools.note: Not a tradition: a field tag for scholarly lectures (philology, history).
